source.title: Open Problems: The Spectrum of the Hilbert Matrix as an Operator on ℓ^p

accepted.question_text: For a complex parameter λ ∈ C \ {-1, -2, -3, ...}, let H_λ be the infinite matrix with entries a_{mn} = (m + n + 1 - λ)^(-1) for m, n = 0, 1, 2, .... When H_λ is viewed as an operator on ℓ^p for 2 < p < ∞, determine its full spectrum, its point spectrum, and its essential spectrum. In particular, for real λ < 1, is the spectrum exactly {π sec(πu) : |Re u| ≤ 1/2 - 1/p}, with interior equal to the point spectrum and boundary equal to the essential spectrum?
accepted.context_brief: Spectrum of generalized Hilbert matrices on ℓ^p

evidence.quote: Given a complex number λ ∈ C \ {−1, −2, −3,...}, we consider the matrix H_λ with coefficients a_mn = (m + n + 1 − λ)^−1, m, n = 0, 1, 2,...
Problem. Determine the spectrum, the point spectrum and the essential spectrum of H_λ as an operator on ℓ^p for 2 < p < ∞.
Conjecture. For λ < 1, the set {π sec πu : |Re u| ≤ 1/2−1/p} is the spectrum, the interior of this set is the point spectrum, and its boundary is the essential spectrum.
